notablePrerequisites: Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Hope Tender.
Activate Hope Tender's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and exerting it, untapping Thawing Glaciers and the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
